title: Onboarding release screenshot & visuals: first-run walkthrough before/after pack
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a dedicated image pack for the Feb 2025 onboarding/quickstart release blog and changelog entry. This ticket covers producing before/after UI comparison screenshots, stylized feature callout overlays, device mockups, and exported assets for docs, blog, and press. The goal is to have a single high-quality asset bundle that PM/marketing can use in the release post and that engineering/docs can use in the changelog. Assets must be accessible, localized-friendly, and follow the export naming conventions. Deliver both light and dark mode variants and provide source Figma file with artboards and export presets.
acceptance_criteria: Exported PNG/JPEG hero banner (3200x1200) showing before/after banner with 1–2 feature callouts
Set of per-feature 1200x675 images for blog inline use (light+dark), with annotation callouts following the Design System style
Figma source file with clearly labeled frames, component instances, and export slices
Accessibility check: all callout text passes 4.5:1 contrast and is readable at recommended sizes
Localization check frames for EN/DE/FR/JA demonstrating layout tolerance (strings up to +40% length)
Export naming and docs: assets_manifest.csv and README describing usage and alt text for each image
asset_specifications: Hero: 3200x1200 px @72dpi, sRGB, exported as PNG with transparent shadows flattened
Feature tiles: 1200x675 px @72dpi, JPEG high quality (85) and PNG for screenshots with code text
Device mockups: scalable SVGs with masked screenshot slots, provide 3 aspect ratios (16:9, 3:2, 4:3)
Callouts: use DS-callout component, weight 600, 18px, rounded pill with 8px padding; arrows are 2px stroke
Spacing: 24px baseline grid, 16px gutters on mobile crops; maintain 24px safe margin for text legibility
Dark mode: inverted backgrounds, preserved elevation with subtle glow, text color tokens: on-surface and accent-700
comments: 2025-02-13 Maya Chen: Initial art directions uploaded to Figma. Created hero wireframes with two composition options — side-by-side split and stacked before/after slider mock. Preference from PM is split for banner, slider for interactive demo in docs.
2025-02-14 Liam O'Connor: Marking which UI elements need privacy masking — user names and API keys masked with blurred overlays. Please add an exported 'privacy-masked' variant for legal review.

2025-02-15 PM Review (Ava Patel): Prefer stronger emphasis on the runtime/batching callout. Request alternate color token for callout to match console accent. Also asked for i18n frames showing German strings (20% longer) — add those by EOD 2025-02-18.

2025-02-17 Design Review (Mateo Ruiz): Noted that callout arrow contrast in dark mode is borderline. Increase stroke weight from 2px to 2.5px and test at 16px scale. Added accessibility checklist to acceptance criteria.

2025-02-19 Liam O'Connor: Uploaded export bundle draft to GitHub PR. Left a note to swap hero composition to use the 'split with soft divider' version. QA found a cropped token graph on the 1200x675 tile — fixed in v1.2 exports.

2025-02-20 Marketing (Sofia Rivera): Approved dark/light heroes. Requested alt text suggestions and concise captions for each feature tile — added to release_images_README.md. Ready for final export and upload to CDN after freeze on 2025-02-21.
